capabilities: Edit OpenAPI specs in a CodeMirror editor with autocompletion, linting and formatting
Render specs as Swagger UI with $ref resolution
Convert spec files between YAML and JSON
Export specs as standalone offline HTML pages, single file or ZIP
Register .yaml/.yml/.json files to open in OpenAPI View by default
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not only a renderer; it also edits specifications and exports them.
extras: Requires enabling the 'Detect all file extensions' option in Settings → Files and Links; the README notes $ref resolution hasn't been widely tested; requires manual enabling of the plugin via community plugins settings.
intentEvidence: Not finding any good options, I decided to create a plugin that allows writing Swagger UI documentation directly in Obsidian
motivation: The author wrote project documentation in Obsidian, then could not find a suitable plugin for API documentation, so they built one to avoid switching between applications.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write, preview, or maintain OpenAPI/Swagger documentation without switching to another application.
summary: OpenAPI spec toolkit that edits specifications in a CodeMirror editor and renders them as Swagger UI inside Obsidian.
